title: A read block equals a prescribed word
statement: Let $\tau:\mathbb N\to\{0,1\}$, $i\in\mathbb N$, and let $\beta$ be a finite bit string. If $\tau(i+j)$ equals the $j$th bit of $\beta$ for every $0\le j<|\beta|$, then the block of $|\beta|$ bits read from position $i$ in $\tau$ is $\beta$.
hypotheses_covered: For every $0\le j<|\beta|$, $\tau(i+j)$ equals the $j$th bit of $\beta$.
